coordinate_system.origin: centre of the main hub deck, at the deck's top surface (y = 0)
coordinate_system.azimuth_zero: +X axis, angles increase toward +Z (viewed from above: counter-clockwise)

scale_basis.summary: Central hub deck diameter ~17 km (dome 15.2 km). Derived from the only available in-universe yardstick: street-level shots inside the Citadel (S3E7) show cars (~4 m), which give building widths and the spacing between towers; extrapolating that to the exterior establishing shot gives a central disc roughly the size of Brooklyn (~15-17 km across). This is the same reasoning used by the community 1:200 000 print model, which independently arrives at a Brooklyn-sized centre disc.
scale_basis.confidence: Exterior proportions are taken from the single recurring establishing shot (S1E10, S3E1, S3E7, S5E10). Everything above the deck plane is well attested; the underside and legs are seen only in that one 3/4 view and are partly inferred.

canonical_references.title: Close Rick-counters of the Rick Kind
canonical_references.note: First exterior establishing shot: central glass dome, three smaller domed districts, stacked metallic plates below, three legs, single antenna. Orange/brown nebula backdrop.

canonical_references.title: The Rickshank Rickdemption
canonical_references.note: Same exterior; Citadel teleported into the Galactic Federation prison and heavily damaged.

canonical_references.title: The Ricklantis Mixup
canonical_references.note: Rebuilt Citadel, same silhouette. Street-level shots used for the scale basis.

canonical_references.title: Rickmurai Jack
canonical_references.note: Exterior seen again before destruction; Mortyburg district detaches.

glass.note: Dome glass: pale teal-green, seen tinted against the nebula

rim_light.note: Orange deck-rim light bands and hangar glow

deck.note: Main disc. Top surface is the ground plane of the central city.

deck_rim_band.note: Slightly proud ring around the deck edge carrying the orange light band and hangar bays.

dome.note: Ellipsoidal glass dome: sphere of radius 7600 m scaled to 0.75 in Y.

dome_ribs.note: Meridian ribs on the dome glass, every 30 degrees.

council_tower.note: Council of Ricks spire at the exact centre; tallest building on the station.

city.note: Skyscrapers under the main dome. Heights bias taller toward the centre so the skyline fits under the dome curve.

hangar_bays.note: Rectangular docking mouths cut into the rim band, lit orange.

antenna.note: Single centralised antenna at the dome apex.

pods.note: Three smaller domed districts (Mortytown, Mortyburg and the third residential district) protruding from the hub. Pod 1 (90 deg) is the district that faces camera-left in the establishing shot.

bridges.note: Hybrid technical/organic connectors between the hub rim and each pod deck. A ribbed tube carries the transit tunnel; a flat deck on top is the pedestrian causeway; two struts below tie into the pod's understructure.

understructure.note: Several metallic plates extend from the bottom of the hub, housing the machinery that keeps the Citadel stable and in orbit.

legs.note: Three legs extrude downward and outward, offset 60 degrees from the pods so they sit between the districts. They let the structure stand when landed.
legs.note2: Leg length ≈ 17.6 km; rake ≈ 21 degrees from vertical.

nebula.note: Orange/brown nebula, brightest behind and slightly below the station in the establishing shot.

show_angle.note: The recurring establishing shot: three-quarter view from slightly above, pod 1 front-left.

overall.note: Computed by tools/make_schematic.py from the values above and written to overall_dimensions.json; also shown live in the viewer.
